extraction.name: Science Question Answering (SCIENCE QA)
extraction.description: A new benchmark that consists of 21k multimodal multiple choice questions with diverse science topics and annotations of their answers with corresponding lectures and explanations.
extraction.creator: Pan Lu, Swaroop Mishra, Tony Xia, Liang Qiu, Kai-Wei Chang, Song-Chun Zhu, Oyvind Tafjord, Peter Clark, Ashwin Kalyan
extraction.publisher: University of California, Los Angeles, Arizona State University, Allen Institute for AI
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset is collected from elementary and high school science curricula.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Elementary and high school science curricula.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Most questions are annotated with grounded lectures and detailed explanations. The lecture provides general knowledge that introduces the background information, and the explanation reveals a specific reason for the answer.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Workers who obtain a high school or higher degree.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Diagnose the multi-hop reasoning ability and interpretability of AI systems, and train language models to generate lectures and explanations as the chain of thought.
